description: This source file defines the LiveActivityManager class which manages the lifecycle of a live activity, including starting, updating, and ending the activity, with a focus on connection health and cleanup in an iOS app. It interacts with ActivityKit to handle live activities and logs relevant events.

classes.name: LiveActivityManager
classes.description: Singleton class managing the state and lifecycle of a live activity related to OpenClaw.

methods.name: startActivity
methods.description: Initializes a new live activity with specified agent name and session key, or handles connection state if one already exists.

methods.name: handleConnecting
methods.description: Updates the current activity to reflect the connecting state.

methods.name: handleReconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity to reflect the idle state, indicating reconnection.

methods.name: handleDisconnect
methods.description: Updates the current activity to reflect disconnection.

methods.name: hydrateCurrentAndPruneDuplicates
methods.description: Retrieves existing activities, keeps the most recent, and dismisses older or duplicate activities.

methods.name: updateCurrent
methods.description: Updates the state of the current activity to a specified connection state.

methods.name: connectingState
methods.description: Returns the content state object representing a connecting status.

methods.name: idleState
methods.description: Returns the content state object representing an idle status.

methods.name: disconnectedState
methods.description: Returns the content state object representing a disconnected status.
